Definition: {above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications}
BiblicalUsage: 1) upon, over, on account of, above, to, against; 1a) upon, over, on account of, regarding, concerning, on behalf of; 1b) over (with verbs of ruling); 1c) above, beyond (in comparison); 1d) to, against (of direction)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
